retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant urban fantasy layout featuring a central portrait framed by magical light trails and a stylized subway-tile header against a purple city silhouette.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central studio portrait of a young woman with wavy hair, positioned against a purple gradient background featuring a stylized city skyline. The composition is framed by swirling white magical sparkles and topped with a decorative sign resembling a subway station plaque with a white brick texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Central subject framed by dynamic magical light trails
Top-heavy title block balanced by a solid bottom footer
Purple monochromatic background contrasting with warm skin tones
Urban skyline silhouette providing depth behind the subject
coreInvariants: White brick/subway tile texture within the top header
Simplified city skyline silhouette in the lower third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, waist-up, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large decorative sign at the top center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top title, follows the magic trails down around the subject, and ends at the bottom text bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample purple space in the upper corners to allow the sparkle effects to breathe.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Blue and Red (found in the subject's clothing and sign borders)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with high-value white highlights for magical effects.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses a heavy, flared serif with a slight upward arch
Secondary title uses a condensed, hand-drawn style serif
Footer text uses a clean, bold geometric sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial letters in the main title are significantly larger (drop caps style)
Letters in the secondary title have irregular, slightly jagged edges for a 'magical' feel
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a decorative, arched display serif with a functional, flat-baseline sans-serif.
graphicDevices: White brick texture background for the sign
Multi-colored dotted border around the sign

preserve: Arched layout of the main title
avoid: Standard horizontal text for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the flared serif look characteristic of 2000s fantasy branding
Matches the clean, bold footer text style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a purple gradient background with a simplified violet city skyline silhouette at the bottom. Add swirling white magical sparkle trails that frame the center. Place a white brick-textured sign with a beveled border at the top center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in an arched flared-serif font inside the sign. Place the secondary title below it in a condensed serif. Add a dark purple bar at the very bottom with centered white sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Does the sign have a white brick texture?
Are there magical sparkles framing the center?
Is the background a purple gradient with a skyline?

mustAchieve: Clean studio lighting on the subject
avoid: Cluttered backgrounds that obscure the subject

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is centered and legible
Ensure the sparkle trails do not cover the face
Verify the white brick texture is visible
Confirm the purple gradient is smooth without banding
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Fantasy Pop = (Studio Portrait + Purple City Silhouette) * (Magical Sparkle Trails + Subway Tile Header)
